اعتمرا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرَا (iʕtamarā) /iʕ.ta.ma.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرَا (uʕtumirā) /uʕ.tu.mi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اِعْتَمِرَا (iʕtamirā) /iʕ.ta.mi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
